_how_to: Each photo needs an image at source/photos/<slug>.jpg. 'note' is an optional line about where or why you took it (leave it empty to hide it). 'painting' links a photo to the painting it inspired (use the painting's slug). Set "reuse": false for a photo of someone else's artwork: it is shown without Download or Pin and is left out of the free-to-use license.
